name: void_fraction_correlations
title: Void-fraction correlations for two-phase flow (13 models, function library)
summary: EES FUNCTION library of the thirteen void-fraction correlations of the LaboThapPy void_fraction module: homogeneous (no slip), Zivi, Fauske, Premoli and Hughmark (slip-ratio family), Lockhart-Martinelli, Graham and Cioncolini-Thome (empirical, the last two respectively condensation-only and annular flow), Armand-Treschev and Bankoff (K times the homogeneous void fraction), and the drift-flux models Rouhani-Axelsson, Dix and Woldesemayat-Ghajar; the Reynolds and Weber numbers Premoli needs are helper functions. Demonstrated on the case of the original example (R410A at 1.2 MPa, 8 mm pipe, 300 kg/m^2.s, ten qualities).

authors: A. Premoli, D. D. Francesco and A. Prina (Premoli void fraction, 1971)
R. W. Lockhart and R. C. Martinelli (Lockhart-Martinelli void fraction, 1949)
D. Chisholm (closed-form approximation of the Lockhart-Martinelli curves, 1967)
V. I. Armand and G. G. Treschev (Armand-Treschev void fraction)
S. Z. Rouhani and E. Axelsson (Rouhani-Axelsson void fraction, 1970)
B. Chexal, J. Horowitz and G. Lellouche (assessment of eight void fraction models, 1986)
M. A. Woldesemayat and A. J. Ghajar (Woldesemayat-Ghajar void fraction, 2007)
A. Cioncolini and J. R. Thome (Cioncolini-Thome void fraction, 2012)

origin.notes: LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47, file labothappy/correlations/void_fraction/void_fraction.py (926 lines, 13 correlation functions plus the compute_void_fraction dispatcher), with the helpers labothappy/correlations/properties/dimensionless.py (compute_reynolds, compute_weber) and labothappy/correlations/properties/two_phase.py (get_saturated_phase_properties). The demonstration cases come from the library example labothappy/correlations/void_fraction/void_fraction_example.py. The module names R. Dickes (PhD thesis, ULiege) and Thome & Cioncolini, 'Void Fraction' (2015, DOI 10.1142/9789814623216_0021) as its presentation sources for the first group of correlations.
